pieces.Text: Imbuing you with negative energy, this spell allows you to paralyze a single living humanoid for the duration of the spell with a successful melee touch attack. A paralyzed subject exudes a carrion stench that causes all living creatures [except you] in a 10-foot-radius spread to become sickened [Fortitude negates]. A neutralize poison spell removes the effect from a sickened creature, and creatures immune to poison are unaffected by the stench.
